items.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
items.summary: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another. However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman, Hugging Face’s chief policy officer, during a discussion at TechCrunch […]
items.creator: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
items.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
items.creator: Julie Bort
